name: ISPRS Potsdam 2D Semantic Labeling Dataset
description: Aerial true orthophotos and digital surface models from Potsdam, Germany, with manually labeled semantic land-cover classes for the ISPRS 2D semantic labeling benchmark. The benchmark provides training labels for a subset of tiles and retains labels for other tiles for evaluation.
citation: ISPRS Working Group III/4. 2D Semantic Labeling Contest – Potsdam. ISPRS Test Project on Urban Classification, 3D Building Reconstruction and Semantic Labeling. https://www.isprs.org/resources/datasets/benchmarks/UrbanSemLab/2d-sem-label-potsdam.aspx

license.notes: No dataset license was published on the confirmed ISPRS Potsdam dataset page; terms are unverified. Contact the provider before reuse or redistribution.
